annotations.text:
CURRENT — DARK. The language that exists in code today: diagonal band, translucent surfaces with a green sheen, Archivo caps over Inter, 20px cards, five-slot footer.

Third is the overlay-card variant: the photo is the card.

Fourth is featured + grid: one full-width carousel card on top, then half-width cards two to a row. Four tournaments visible instead of two, and the squarer card gives the name less room — so the long ones wrap to two lines.
CURRENT — LIGHT. Warm off-white, not white. The brand green, the PLAY gradient, the points sparkle and the partner navy keep their exact values across both grounds; everything else flips.
SIGNAL. Near-white, hard 2px rules instead of cards, square corners, Outfit, one green and one amber. Drawn only — no code behind these yet.

NOT HERE: Court, Club board, Broadcast, Editorial, both Arcade palettes, Signal dark, and the personalised "Today" feed.

Court and Club board were drawn and then removed from the branch — they survive in git history at commit f2af04d, so they are a `git show` away rather than a redraw.

Every screen above also lives in Storybook, under Experiments / All Screens.
